title: MCP Smoke
description: Minimal fixture world for the foundry-mcp-live e2e smoke test. Derived from the shape of a real Shadowdark v14 world, with no content: no scenes, no actors, no journals, no chat, and none of the world-level compendium packs, which are third-party module content and not ours to redistribute. Foundry initialises the empty collections on first launch.
